Morgan has 60 female friends and 50 male friends.

- 30% of her female friends live in town, so 70% live out of town.
  Number of out-of-town female friends = 70% of 60 = 0.7 × 60 = 42

- 40% of her male friends live in town, so 60% live out of town.
  Number of out-of-town male friends = 60% of 50 = 0.6 × 50 = 30

Total out-of-town friends = 42 + 30 = 72

Answer: B
